A '''Senator''' of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] people served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], before the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] on the order of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. In revenge, the Echani [[General/Legends|general]] [[Yusanis]] attacked Revan, but was killed in battle.
